text:
Lara (marketing): Quick alert — several webinar signups aren't getting the webinar tag and routing to low-touch. Need a 15m mitigation so we don't lose warm registrants.
Omar (revops): Looking at logs: HubSpot webhook sometimes strips query params. The raw form payload includes `referrer` with utm_campaign but HS normalization clears it before workflows run.
Nate (SDR): We already missed a few live attendees. Can we temp-route by email_list header or referrer parse?
Priya (sales-ops): Temp rule: if `email_list == "webinar_live"` OR `referrer` contains `utm_campaign=webinar` then add `tag=webinar_hot` and route to `webinar_sdr_pool`. Escalate to on-call at 120s. I'll update the SLA note.
Omar (revops): I'll spin up a tiny serverless enrichment to parse raw payload and set `webinar_hot` before RR. Make it idempotent. Also recommend rotation_timeout=20s + claim_jitter=rand(0,3).
DevBot: Deployed pipeline: `parse-referrer-enrich v1` -> staging.
Omar (revops): Patch pushed to prod, monitoring on `lead.claim.latency.webinar_hot`. Backfill script retagged 27 leads; 6 required manual claims. CSV uploaded to #sales.
Nate (SDR): Got the CSV, claiming manually now. Will follow up on owners for the 6 manual ones.
Lara (marketing): Thanks — action items recap: Priya update SLA doc + HS workflow text; Omar monitor and confirm p95; Nate handle manual claims; I'll add guidance to the webinar runbook about ensuring utm_campaign in forms. Reconvene in 09:00 standup. :thumbsup:
